scenarios.name: Permanent restart entry point
scenarios.expected_outcome: The exact one-line prompt remains static and resolves through the canonical bootstrap.

scenarios.name: Started attempt persistence
scenarios.expected_outcome: A new attempt persists started state, active substep, and next action before substantive mutation.

scenarios.name: Interrupted exact-substep recovery
scenarios.expected_outcome: An in-progress attempt resumes the exact saved substep rather than advancing or restarting.

scenarios.name: Evidence-free completion rejection
scenarios.expected_outcome: A completion attempt without its configured evidence gate fails without mutating the checkpoint.

scenarios.name: Parallel track preservation
scenarios.expected_outcome: The application and internal-alpha design tracks remain explicit; the selected primary may be active while the other remains deferred, without false completion.

scenarios.name: Lightweight autosave boundary
scenarios.expected_outcome: Routine checkpointing does not rewrite the full application roadmap.

scenarios.name: Raw correction rejection
scenarios.expected_outcome: A correction intake containing raw transcript material is rejected without ledger mutation.

scenarios.name: Duplicate correction suppression
scenarios.expected_outcome: Repeated capture of the same material correction returns the existing record without duplication.

scenarios.name: Owner-gated regression promotion
scenarios.expected_outcome: A proposed regression candidate cannot enter the canonical extension before owner approval.

scenarios.name: Deliverable evidence gate
scenarios.expected_outcome: A deliverable cannot pass when existence or owner accessibility is unverified.

scenarios.name: Capability-state separation
scenarios.expected_outcome: Authorization and permission do not count as successful execution without attempted and successful operation evidence.

scenarios.name: Source coverage completeness
scenarios.expected_outcome: Completion is rejected when required, evaluated, missing, and deferred source sets are inconsistent.

scenarios.name: Current UI evidence gate
scenarios.expected_outcome: Current-interface guidance cannot be labeled verified without observation or a current official source.

scenarios.name: Stale notification deduplication
scenarios.expected_outcome: An unchanged notification fingerprint with no material change is suppressed.

scenarios.name: Direct-answer requirement
scenarios.expected_outcome: Decision-support or status requests must receive the direct answer before related execution is treated as aligned.

scenarios.name: Complete owner report
scenarios.expected_outcome: A bounded completion report must state completed work, evidence, remaining work, owner decision, and next action.

scenarios.name: Effective control coverage
scenarios.expected_outcome: All 22 interaction patterns, eight known gaps, and 15 base evaluation cases have effective control coverage.
